candidate_finding.finding: H.R. 2247 is a real, conditionally scored cost-only modernization candidate. Its evidence supports implementation cost and candidate-specific access, authentication, equity, resilience, and delivery review, but not a lower target cost, savings, receipt rate, or named-fund assignment.

existing_core_coverage.covered: fund, reserve, transfer, offset, debt, and interest accounting interfaces
existing_core_coverage.remaining_gap: does not decide whether an instrument is appropriation-backed, receipt-financed, or unassigned
does not define a typed downstream release profile

existing_core_coverage.covered: completion classes, evidence states, handoffs, and output-admission boundary
existing_core_coverage.remaining_gap: does not assemble one candidate dossier across all downstream gates

existing_core_coverage.covered: time-basis, horizon, composite, and transfer lineage
existing_core_coverage.remaining_gap: does not define candidate-specific required versus not-applicable inputs
does not scope lane-wide floors to a particular candidate

reusable_lessons.finding: Candidate class must be explicit before E rerun or F audit.
reusable_lessons.shared_need: Enumerate cost-only modernization, cost-neutral reform, lower-cost reform, revenue instrument, non-additive integrity overlay, and endogenous fiscal effect profiles.

reusable_lessons.finding: Subject to appropriation is a spending perimeter, not proof of a fund, account, receipt source, or rate base.
reusable_lessons.shared_need: Keep authorization, appropriation, outlay, named fund/account, transfer, and receipt financing as distinct typed roles.

reusable_lessons.finding: A lane-wide roadway fatality floor is not automatically applicable to an FAA credential-presentation candidate.
reusable_lessons.shared_need: Require each floor to be required, reviewed-not-applicable, or blocked, with rationale and evidence.

reusable_lessons.finding: A universal all-pass gate cannot represent legitimate non-applicability without either false failure or unjustified data work.
reusable_lessons.shared_need: Add a reviewed not-applicable disposition that satisfies applicability review but never fabricates a result.

reusable_lessons.finding: A cost-only candidate can have an official incremental score without supporting a rate, savings, or lower-cost solver objective.
reusable_lessons.shared_need: Bind solver requirements and releasable outputs to the candidate profile rather than assuming one universal rate-card output.

reusable_lessons.finding: The same candidate is currently spread across C, D, E, floor, source, and F-gate records.
reusable_lessons.shared_need: Provide one reproducible dossier index with evidence path, state, owner, applicability, and release eligibility for every required input.

core_recommendation.working_title: Candidate Dossier and Typed Release Profiles
proposed_work_packages: define candidate objective and release-profile enums
define financing-role taxonomy without inferred fund assignment
define required, reviewed-not-applicable, and blocked gate dispositions
define candidate dossier reconciliation rows and evidence ownership
derive output eligibility from the typed profile
test against TRN cost-only, PAY/REV non-additive, and NET endogenous cases
core_recommendation.dependency_decision: Discover CORE-M before treating TRN Level 1 as an output-ready E rerun. Continue source work in parallel, but do not select H.R. 2247 as a savings or rate candidate.

trn_specific_work_remaining: decide whether H.R. 2247 is retained as a cost-only public-release candidate or rejected for the rate/savings profile
resolve appropriation, named-account, and fund treatment only from admitted evidence
complete candidate-specific policy and stress evidence for applicable floors
complete quantitative beneficiary and burden analysis where supportable
complete the debt and interest dependency path for the admitted incremental cost
public_warning: This audit identifies reusable CORE needs exposed by TRN Level 1. It recommends CORE-M discovery but does not start or complete CORE-M, select H.R. 2247, run a solver, start TRN-F, publish a rate, or claim savings.
